svg.title: Figure 4 | Completeness-check states and primary actions
svg.desc: The four rows associate possible states with actions, not four steps that must always occur. Completeness does not establish formal review or approval.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4 | Completeness-check states and primary actions
Confirm the inputs. The primary action is Check data.
Show progress, prevent duplicate submission and explain that
Identify the omission. The primary action becomes Fill in missing
Show the result for this check. Offer Preview and Export report
The four rows associate possible states with actions, not four steps
that must always occur. Completeness does not establish formal review
